summary: CoreWeave, Inc. filed an 8-K on September 22, 2026, announcing the closing of an upsized $4.2 billion private offering of 2.875% convertible senior notes due 2033, including $500 million from the full exercise of the initial purchasers' option. The notes are senior unsecured obligations guaranteed by subsidiaries that guarantee CoreWeave's existing senior notes. Interest is payable semiannually beginning April 1, 2027, and the notes mature April 1, 2033, unless converted, redeemed, or repurchased. The offering was made to qualified institutional buyers under Rule 144A, with U.S. Bank Trust Company as trustee. The capital raise strengthens liquidity but adds convertible overhang; watch conversion terms and potential dilution.
